title: Finite-Memory Projection Corrections
description: Public method-note package for a bounded finite-memory projection correction in cosmological consistency diagnostics. The package presents a reproducible, predeclared diagnostic operator and comparison protocol for reconstruction-level envelopes. It does not claim that the K2 operator is a final cosmological law, that a background theory is established, or that the current diagnostics constitute a direct measurement claim.
notes: This release is a diagnostic method-note snapshot, not empirical validation of a new cosmological model.
